Upstream: https://github.com/iptag/jimeng-api
Pinned commit: b9a4199e5a273415f9dd3155246e9bb39ace4395
Upstream runtime version: 1.6.3
C.le integration version: 1.6.3-cle.1
License: GPL-3.0 (see LICENSE)

Integration layout
- Upstream TypeScript source remains under third_party/jimeng-api.
- The standalone Windows sidecar is under sidecars/jimeng-api/bin.
- Runtime configuration, logs and PID state are generated in the C.le data directory.
- The sidecar is process-isolated and survives closing the C.le UI.

C.le compatibility and hardening
- Added GET /healthz.
- Added OpenAI-style POST /v1/images/edits as an alias of image composition.
- Expanded GET /v1/models to the complete image/video catalog used by C.le.
- Fixed upstream TypeScript errors and upgraded runtime dependencies to an audit-clean set.
- C.le validates model-region compatibility before selecting an account.
- C.le performs priority-based account failover and repairs a crashed local sidecar on connection refusal.
- A watchdog restarts an enabled service after unexpected exits.
- One-click diagnostics verifies the executable, writable runtime, health endpoint, model catalog and account configuration.

Reproducible commands
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-jimeng-sidecar.ps1
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/smoke-jimeng-sidecar.ps1

Packaging
TypeScript is bundled with esbuild and packaged as a standalone Node executable with @yao-pkg/pkg. The pkg dynamic-plugin warning is non-operative for this application because jimeng-api does not load optional @colors/colors plugins at runtime.
